steps.description: Fit DESeq2 with raw integer counts (no length correction, no tximport, per STAR/featureCounts origin) and design ~ subject + condition, with condition releveled so 'control' is the explicit reference. plan.title: Paired DESeq2: treatment effect within subject
plan.analytical_narrative: Design context: 5 subjects, each contributing one control and one treated blood sample (paired, within-subject), raw STAR/featureCounts integer counts over 12,000 genes x 10 samples. The research question — which genes respond to treatment within each subject — is answered by a paired differential expression test that removes between-subject variance with a subject blocking term, per DESeq2 best practice for paired designs (design ~ subject + condition). The plan proceeds: (1) QC on sample structure to confirm samples pair correctly and no outlier sample dominates variance, (2) minimal low-count pre-filter, (3) DESeq2 model with subject + condition design and explicit control reference level, (4) Wald test on the condition coefficient with apeglm shrinkage of the fold change, (5) BH-adjusted significance calling with independent filtering, (6) preranked GSEA against Hallmark and Reactome gene sets on the Wald statistic to characterize the coordinated pathway-level response, and (7) a consolidated report with all diagnostics, gene tables, and reproducibility records. All steps are grounded in the Inflexa knowledge service's paired bulk RNA-seq DESeq2 procedure (rules R-0011, R-0001, R-0036, R-0064, R-0029/R-0002, R-0026, R-0009, R-0010/R-0043, R-0007/R-0045/R-0048/R-0098/R-0101, R-0041/R-0051/R-0085/R-0086/R-0105).

fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, Hallmark then Reactome
